description: This file is a script written in JavaScript using Node.js, which performs static analysis on source code files to identify specific violations related to pairing-store API call usage. It imports TypeScript compiler APIs and custom utility modules to parse and analyze source files.

methods.name: isUndefinedLikeExpression
methods.description: Checks if a given AST node represents the literal 'undefined' or 'null'.

methods.name: hasRequiredAccountIdProperty
methods.description: Determines if an object literal node contains an 'accountId' property that is neither undefined nor null.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Traverses the provided source content to find API call violations related to pairing store API usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that collects violations from source files and reports any unscoped pairing-store calls.
